data.name: Windward
data.description: Aetherion with a thread of skyglass down the fuller and a grip wrapped in old sailcloth. It burns like a deck lantern on a long watch.

data.name: Riptide
data.description: Thornsilver cooled in the Foundry's flood, with a row of skyglass beads set down its spine.

data.name: Nightreaver
data.description: The blackened blade of judgment, with one skyglass star at the guard, like the last lamp left lit on deck.

data.name: Thunderwake
data.description: Stormrender with a skyglass storm-rod set into the crossguard, the kind the war-ship carried at its mastheads.

data.name: Anchorline
data.description: Every white prayer knot on the chain is a skyglass bead now: one for each name on the duty roster.

data.name: Starfall
data.description: The bow's vow script is overwritten with the Wayfinder's chart lines in skyglass, corrected and corrected again.

data.name: Keelstone
data.description: The spear's earth crystal is a shard of skyglass cut from the wreck's keel, and the shaft is banded in ship's iron.

data.name: Skyglass Kote
data.description: Armoured sleeves cut whole from the wreck's raw skyglass and left unpolished. They gleam even in the dark of the hold.

data.name: Lastlight Duskblade
data.description: Pure silver around a heart of skyglass that glows like the Lastlight Lantern, faint and pointing home.

data.name: Skysail
data.description: The green crystal is skyglass now, and the ribs are strung like the war-ship's sails.

data.name: Hullbreaker
data.description: Yuki's axe on a haft of ship's timber, skyglass set into the cheek of the head. It has opened a few hulls.

data.name: Captain's Gunbai
data.description: The Captain's war fan, black lacquer with the four-point star in skyglass at its heart. He gave his orders with it for decades.

data.name: Rotbloom
data.description: A sickle on a chain of rotten rope, cloudy skyglass blooming along the blade where the Core remembered it wrong.

data.name: Forgefists
data.description: Forge-blackened gauntlets with maul-head knuckles, seamed with cooled skyglass. The Foundry Warden never set his work down.

data.name: Wayfinder
data.description: A compass rose of skyglass in the guard, and the Wayfinder's last heading etched down the fuller. It still points at a port that is not there.

data.name: Sealscript
data.description: The sword of sealing, written end to end in the Sealwright's script, a skyglass seal at the pommel. It remembers every report he buried.

data.name: Captain's Gunbai
data.description:
Taken from the Captain on his own deck. He gave every order with it, and every order was his master's.

Unlocks Captain's Gunbai, a variant of The Unwritten (new look and name, same stats). You must own The Unwritten: open it, choose Variants, then Use Captain's Gunbai. Once per player.

data.name: Rotbloom
data.description:
Cut from what the Core Horror left behind when it finally lay still.

Unlocks Rotbloom, a variant of Oathbinder (new look and name, same stats). You must own Oathbinder: open it, choose Variants, then Use Rotbloom. Once per player.

data.name: Forgefists
data.description:
The Foundry Warden never set down his work. Now someone else can carry it.

Unlocks Forgefists, a variant of Warden's Bracers (new look and name, same stats). You must own Warden's Bracers: open it, choose Variants, then Use Forgefists. Once per player.

data.name: Wayfinder
data.description:
The Wayfinder's last correction, still pointing at a port that is not there.

Unlocks Wayfinder, a variant of Stormrender (new look and name, same stats). You must own Stormrender: open it, choose Variants, then Use Wayfinder. Once per player.

data.name: Sealscript
data.description:
The Sealwright's own seal, from the hand that buried every report.

Unlocks Sealscript, a variant of Whispering Dawnblade (new look and name, same stats). You must own Whispering Dawnblade: open it, choose Variants, then Use Sealscript. Once per player.

The seal of the iron reliquary chained behind the Sealwright, where the echoes the Core could not hold were sealed away.

The Sealed Reliquary · Battle Arena
Difficulty: ★★★☆☆
Chance drops: Lastlight Lantern 15% · Sealed Treasury 6% · Forgefists, Sealscript, The First Blade variants 2% each
Choose one: Skyglass Coffer ×2 · Sealed Treasury · Skyglass Token ×2 · Archive Chart Case ×2
Steep it: use it from your inventory: 3 Core Rot → a Legendary chart.
Spent when the run starts. No refills between fights; once inside, you leave by winning, falling or abandoning. Claim any waiting reward first.
